entries.speaker: kira
entries.text: Hey, this is Kira on Radio Chipset, one oh seven point seven. We're on the air twenty-four seven, so get comfortable. Mina, how's the tower looking?

entries.speaker: mina
entries.text: Thanks, Kira. Quick heads-up: there are supply chests scattered around the room. Crack a couple open before anything starts moving. We'll sort out the rest as we go.

entries.speaker: nyx
entries.text: Room scanned! Point the crosshair at the supply chests. One shot opens them and charges your arsenal.

entries.speaker: nyx
entries.text: Heads up, a breach is tearing open on the north wall. Get ready, things are about to get busy.

entries.speaker: nyx
entries.text: Here comes the first one. A scout Cyber-Spider, all yours.

entries.speaker: nyx
entries.text: Second wave, and there are two of them. I'll distract them, you take the experience.

entries.speaker: nyx
entries.text: Nice shooting. You've got three seconds to reload before the next wave.

entries.speaker: nyx
entries.text: I'm only tapping it to throw it off. The finishing blow is yours, I'm not stealing your XP.

entries.speaker: kira
entries.text: Attention, listeners. The breach just got wider and something big is coming through. Everybody to your stations.

entries.speaker: nyx
entries.text: Warm-up's over. I'm taking position and opening heavy fire on the Centurion.

entries.speaker: kira
entries.text: Things are heating up. Mina, turn it up. That Centurion is hurt and the music needs to keep pace.

entries.speaker: nyx
entries.text: Mina, Kira, the Centurion's armor is almost gone. Crank the battle track, she's about to finish it.

entries.speaker: nyx
entries.text: Target down! What a shot. Mina, Kira, it's your turn.

entries.speaker: mina
entries.text: Boss is down. Thanks for staying with us. We're back on Radio Chipset with something easy until the next breach.

entries.speaker: kira
entries.text: Breaking from the tower: people on block seven swear the streetlights flicker in time with the music. The technicians say it's a coincidence. We're not so sure.

entries.speaker: mina
entries.text: Dimensional traffic report: the north breach hasn't opened in three days. The crows are perching on the antennas again, which is usually a good sign.

entries.speaker: kira
entries.text: The scrap market in district four has a new coffee stall with synthetic caffeine. Half-hour line and nobody's complaining. That's city life for you.

entries.speaker: mina
entries.text: Notice for couriers: the canal bridge is still closed for repairs. A maintenance drone fell asleep on top of it, literally. Take the dock route.

entries.speaker: kira
entries.text: It's official: the tower's stray cat won the neighborhood contest again. Second year running. The judges were holograms and couldn't resist.

entries.speaker: mina
entries.text: This week's agenda: Friday there's a synthesizer concert on the tower roof. Free entry, bring your own chair.

entries.speaker: kira
entries.text: This Saturday, a chess tournament with holographic pieces in Clock Square. Win and you take home a helmet with lights. Lose and you still get a coffee.

entries.speaker: mina
entries.text: Sunday is the old radio flea market by the lighthouse. Expect stalls of cables, vacuum tubes, and a surprise nobody wanted to explain.

entries.speaker: kira
entries.text: Broadcast update: we swapped the tower antenna and the signal now reaches the harbor district. If you hear static, let us know.

entries.speaker: mina
entries.text: A note from the newsroom: starting today, the late-night music will be calmer. The folks on the top floor have been asking for weeks.

entries.speaker: kira
entries.text: Fun fact of the day: Cyber-Spiders can't look up. A technician found out by accident, standing on a ladder with a flashlight.

entries.speaker: mina
entries.text: Little-known fact: we picked one oh seven point seven because it was the only free frequency between two talk stations. Nobody misses them.

entries.speaker: kira
entries.text: Did you know Nyx switches to power-saving mode when nobody's looking? They say she purrs. She denies it.

entries.speaker: mina
entries.text: Curiosity: the Quantum Centurion wears a nine on its chest because the previous eight broke down on day one.

entries.speaker: kira
entries.text: Fact of the day: the tower has more antennas than windows. Mina counted them twice and got a different number each time.
